{
  "contract": "Every message Cal.com generates on behalf of an event type — the booking page, the confirmation/rescheduled/awaiting-payment emails, the pre-booking email verification code, workflow reminders, and anything sent after a paid booking is captured — must decide whether to render Cal.com's own name and logo from a single resolution of the event's owning entity's `hideBranding` OR-ed with its parent organization's `hideBranding`, and that one resolution must be reached identically whether the event belongs to a team (team.hideBranding OR team.parent.hideBranding) or to an individual member (user.hideBranding OR user.profile.organization.hideBranding). No send path may substitute a narrower predicate (owner-only, entity-only-without-org, or platformClientId-only), and no send path may render branding because the resolved value never reached it.",
  "defect_location": {
    "repo": "calcom/cal.com",
    "summary": "The correct resolution exists in exactly one place and no email path uses it. packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-45 defines resolveHideBranding (org overrides entity) and :85-110 branches team vs owner; the booking pages consume it (apps/web/lib/team/[slug]/[type]/getServerSideProps.tsx:196-211 via shouldHideBrandingForTeamEvent, apps/web/server/lib/[user]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:301-314 via shouldHideBrandingForUserEvent, apps/web/lib/d/[link]/[slug]/getServerSideProps.tsx:104-107, apps/web/modules/bookings/views/bookings-single-view.getServerSideProps.tsx:247-258), which is why the page people book on is correct while the messages are not. (1) Confirmation/reschedule/awaiting-payment emails: packages/emails/src/templates/BaseScheduledEmail.tsx:66-68 sets hideLogo={Boolean(props.calEvent.platformClientId)} — the only suppression is for platform bookings, and packages/types/Calendar.d.ts:163-233 has no hideBranding member for the decision to travel on (it carries hideCalendarNotes, hideOrganizerEmail, platformClientId but nothing for branding), so packages/emails/email-manager.ts:121-140 and :406-437 hand the templates an event that cannot express the setting; packages/emails/src/components/BaseEmailHtml.tsx:196-200 renders EmailBodyLogo whenever hideLogo is falsy. (2) Team-vs-personal divergence in reminders: packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:518-535 defines a private shouldHideBranding whose team branch returns only `!!booking.eventType.team.hideBranding` (dropping team.parent/org entirely) while its user branch returns `!!booking.user?.hideBranding`; it feeds isBrandingDisabled at :245-260, :271-288 and :421-440, so an org-level setting hides branding for a member's own event but not for that org's team event. (3) The same owner-only predicate is repeated on every workflow/reminder scheduling site: packages/features/bookings/lib/service/RegularBookingService.ts:2611-2625 and :2799-2825 pass `!!eventType.owner?.hideBranding || !!platformClientId`, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleConfirmation.ts:451-476 passes `!!updatedBookings[index].eventType?.owner?.hideBranding`, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleBookingRequested.ts:100-110, packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/confirm.handler.ts:556-570, packages/features/handleMarkNoShow.ts:398-408, packages/features/ee/round-robin/roundRobinManualReassignment.ts:661-671 — `eventType.owner` is null for a team event, so the predicate is always false there; packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking/getEventTypesFromDB.ts:109-113 selects only `owner: { hideBranding }` and its team select at :42-52 omits hideBranding/parent, so the data for a correct resolution is never even fetched. (4) After a paid booking: packages/app-store/_utils/payments/handlePaymentSuccess.ts:226-234 uses `!!booking.eventType?.owner?.hideBranding` for BOOKING_PAID and then calls sendScheduledEmailsAndSMS at :265 with an evt built by packages/features/bookings/lib/payment/getBooking.ts:167-207 that never sets any branding field even though :36-42 already selects eventType.owner.hideBranding, and whose team select at :84-90 omits hideBranding and parent. (5) The pre-booking verification code: apps/web/modules/bookings/hooks/useVerifyEmail.ts:55-59 sends only email/username/language; packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/auth/sendVerifyEmailCode.schema.ts:3-15 has no event or branding field; the handler at packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/auth/sendVerifyEmailCode.handler.ts:33-38 forwards those four fields to packages/features/auth/lib/verifyEmail.ts:88-118, which calls sendEmailVerificationCode with user/code/language only; packages/emails/auth-email-service.ts:31-33 constructs AttendeeVerifyEmail (packages/emails/templates/attendee-verify-email.ts:18-31) which renders packages/emails/src/templates/VerifyEmailByCode.tsx:9-13 — a BaseEmailHtml with no hideLogo prop at all — and packages/emails/lib/types/email-types.ts:16-23 (EmailVerifyCode) has no field to carry the setting, so this message always shows the vendor mark."
